newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to tender for 108,000T U.S. corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to tender for 108,000T U.S. corn.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP group of importers will tender on Thursday for two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. corn, local traders said on Wednesday.
The first shipment, specified for FOB, would be slated for December 10-25 from the U.S. Gulf, traders said.
The second shipment would be slated for January 10-25 from the U.S. Gulf or January 26 to February 9 from the Pacific Northwest, they said.
The FGEP buying group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprises, President Enterprises and unlisted Ever Smile Feed Mill Co.
